def.brief: Write tests/test_s2.py: the contract tests for Q-link, written to fail now (build.py does not handle content/links/ yet). Same harness as tests/test_s1.py: each test makes a temporary directory with its own content/ (posts and content/links/*.json) and runs build.py there with sys.executable, then reads docs/. Cover every sentence of Q-link: the link file's shape and event rules; the current reason; a removed link not shown; the anchor found exactly once in the from-post's applied body (missing or twice: build error naming the link file); the anchor becoming a link to the to-post with a superscript [n] right after it, n in order of appearance; the 주석 list with the to-post's title (or first-paragraph stand-in), current reason and created time as <time>; the receiving post's '이 글을 가리키는 글' list; unknown from/to: build error. Touch nothing but tests/test_s2.py.
